children: Safety announced it entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Mapfre with the HSR waiting period expired.
Safety entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to be acquired by Mapfre, with Safety to become a wholly owned subsidiary.
The Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 14, 2026, satisfying one closing condition.
Closing remains subject to other customary conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals.
Definitive proxy statement was mailed to stockholders on or about September 14, 2026; shareholders urged to review SEC filings.
